rv.q: It makes the environmental point brilliantly enough on its own.

The episode is the inspiration for this new sung-through musical from Sleeping Warrior’s Andy McGregor (composer) and playwright Isla Cowan – a propulsive, punchy show that makes up for what it lacks in subtlety and sophistication with heart and humour.
For now, this is a punchy and promising production sure to entertain audiences wherever it pitches its girders.

cn.t: Critics praise this ambitious sung-through musical about Greenpeace's 1990s Brent Spar occupation as bold and heartfelt, with reviewers awarding it strong marks for its environmental storytelling and scope.
